date_scope_check.qualification:
R2-EA-009-D1: The onset differs between February 23 and February 24 in contemporary reporting. Actual inbound trucks on September 26 provide a scoped reopening; this is separate from the renewed September 28 suspension.

R2-EA-009-C3: The September 28–October 7 notice is a scheduled window; October 8 was an anticipated restart, not verified actual reopening. By January 11, 2023, customs officials reported daily exports through the crossing. Use that as a partial later-access bound only. Exact intervening dates, continuous closure and all-category normalization remain unestablished.
